reader.requirement: At --std 85, SUBTRACT format 1 adds every operand before FROM (identifiers and numeric literals) into one temporary formed before any receiver is stored, then subtracts that temporary from each identifier-2 in written order, each receiver identified as it is stored (§1985:VI.6.4.6), with its own ROUNDED, an unsigned receiver taking the magnitude, and the ON SIZE ERROR rules of §1985:VI.6.4.2 (affected receivers unchanged with the phrase, others stored).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 an unphrased size error is caught, the affected resultant left as formed or unchanged, later receivers stored and execution continues (§1985:VI.6.4.2); from 2002 the fatal-EC shape
data.Edition.MaxDigits: composite cap 18 at 85, 31 from 2002 (syntax-rule screen on the same path)

reader.edition-search: grep of DialectLevel|DialectBehaviors|MaxDigits|Edition.Year over ArithmeticBinder.cs, ArithmeticEmitter.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, ExpressionBinder.cs#IdentifiedAtStore, StatementEmitter.cs; the two hits above are the only switches on the format-1 path (ArithmeticEmitter#UnsignedSubsidiary is DIVIDE-only).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: an unphrased size error continues at 85 (undefined value, statement after runs) where 2002+ treat it as a fatal exception condition; the composite cap is 18 at 85 against 31; the temporary-sum and left-to-right store semantics are the same arm.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover multiple receivers, the initial evaluation and receiver identification at store; not exercised: ROUNDED per receiver, unsigned receiver magnitude, unphrased size error at 85, 19-digit temporary sums, P-scaled operands, COMP/COMP-3 aliasing receivers.

reader.notes: EmitInPlace folds the minuends once (Fold), snapshots it when several receivers or a run-time-identified receiver exist, and StoreInPlace subtracts it from each receiver in order; ResolveReceivingAtStore defers subscript identification to each store, which is exactly §1985:VI.6.4.6's expansion. Every probe printed the value the 1985 text gives.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-114/rsub1-001): 0 - 2.5 ROUNDED into S9 -> -3 (§1985:VI.6.4.1 absolute value increased); SUBTRACT 1.5 FROM R ROUNDED R2 -> -2 -1 (ROUNDED per receiver); PIC 9 value 9 minus -0.6 ROUNDED -> SIZE, unchanged 9 (rounding before size check), unrounded -> NOSIZE 9; S9(4) COMP -9999 minus 1 -> SIZE, unchanged (BINARY limit is the PICTURE's); unsigned 5-20 -> SIZE unchanged 5, 5-14 -> 9 (magnitude); SUBTRACT WE(I) FROM I WE(I) with I=2, WE=(7,3) -> I=1, WE(1)=4 (temp formed first, WE(I) identified after I stored, §1985:VI.6.4.6).
